Source.Name: shader-slang
Source.Summary: Shading language for large, high-performance shader codebases
Source.Description: Slang is a shading language and compiler for building and maintaining large shader codebases. It accepts HLSL-like source and generates code for Vulkan, Direct3D, Metal, CUDA, and CPU targets.
